name: Prowler

abilityDetails.Falter: Rakibin bir sonraki saldırısının ıskalamasına sebep olur.
abilityDetails.Power Lock: Hedefin herhangi bir yolla güç kazanmasını engeller.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.

signatureAbility:
Courtesy of The Prowler
While the Opponent is Faltered, Prowler gains +[687.5 - 4,125] Critical Rating.
While Prowler has at least 30 Fury effects, his Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.
immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔥
• Sendeleme Bağışıklığı 👻🚫

abilitySections.title: Prowler's Suit - Always Active
content: Custom-made flak armor grants Immunity to Bleed and Incinerate, and increases Prowler's Block Proficiency during the Opponent's Special Attacks by +[1,480.77].
Unyielding, unrelenting. Prowler is Immune to Falter and has 115% Ability Accuracy.
Prowler does not benefit from the Collar Tech Mastery. Instead, he gains +[114.58] Critical Damage Rating for each rank invested.

abilitySections.title: Pneumatic Gauntlets
content: Medium Attacks are non-contact pneumatic blasts that cannot be Evaded.
When Prowler would land a Critical Hit, he instead inflicts a Rupture Passive dealing the Critical Damage the hit would have dealt as Physical Damage over 1 second.

abilitySections.title: Gas Pellets - Falter
content: Prowler's second Medium Attack inflicts a Falter Passive for 3 seconds, paused during his Special Attacks, which can not be inflicted if the Opponent is already Faltered. If it causes a Miss, it goes on cooldown for 10 seconds.
If Prowler's Special Attacks would be Punished, he inflicts a Falter Passive for 1 second.
While the Opponent is Faltered, they are more aggressive.

abilitySections.title: Power Creep - Max: 30
content: After the Opponent activates a Special Attack, Power Drain their remaining Power and inflict a Power Lock Passive lasting for 1.5 seconds after the final hit of their attack.
For every 1.1% of the Opponent's Max Power that is Drained or Burned, gain 1 Power Creep Charge.
On Prowler's Special Attack activation, each Charge is converted into a Fury Passive granting +[375.44] Attack Rating for 10 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. Max stacks: 30.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Landing a Heavy Attack against an Opponent with 0 Power causes the final 4 hits to inflict a non-stacking Incinerate Debuff dealing [14,079] Energy Damage over 20 seconds.
If a personal Rupture expires on an Incinerated Opponent, it explodes, dealing a burst of [4,223.7] Physical Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a Pursuit Passive for 30 seconds.
The final hit inflicts a Taunt Debuff for 4 seconds.
This Special Attack does not grant Power to the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The first hit refreshes and pauses all personal Ruptures until the final hit of this Special Attack.
Each hit inflicts a Rupture Passive dealing [1,877.2] Physical Damage over 1 second.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Prowler ditches the niceties and Overcharges his gauntlets until the end of his next Special Attack.

While Overcharged, Prowler gains +50% Combat Power Rate, but cannot activate Special Attacks 2 or 3. Additionally, Power Creep Charges are not removed on conversion, and new Fury Passives do not count towards the cap.
As an Attacker, grant the Opponent a 100% Power Efficiency Passive for 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Courtesy of The Prowler
content: While the Opponent is Faltered, Prowler gains +[687.5 - 4,125] Critical Rating.
While Prowler has at least 30 Fury effects, his Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.
